residual_findings.title: Unstable handleSave reference in useEffect dependency array (3 inspector files)
residual_findings.note: handleSave is declared as async function inside component body without useCallback. Reference changes every render, causing useEffect to re-fire continuously. lastHandledTriggerRef guard prevents duplicate API calls in practice, but violates React hooks contract. Fix: wrap handleSave in useCallback with proper dependencies.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed in V1.72 Greptile hotfix PR #98 (merged at e41392a1b7e604297e0554ef0bfd8cb73ca547b7); review thread resolved by Greptile (5/5 confidence).

residual_findings.title: Volume select fires structural patch immediately on change (UX inconsistency)
residual_findings.note: Volume dropdown onChange calls onMove (handleStructure → patchStructure.mutate) immediately, while title/slug/status/planned_word_count accumulate into local state and dispatch only on Save click. UX inconsistency + risk of accidental revision-bumping dispatch. Fix: update volume local state in onChange and dispatch via the same save() path (set.volume in OutlinePatchChapterRequest) as other fields.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed in V1.72 Greptile hotfix PR #98 (merged at e41392a1b7e604297e0554ef0bfd8cb73ca547b7); review thread resolved by Greptile (5/5 confidence).

residual_findings.title: Keychain password written to GITHUB_OUTPUT but never read by subsequent steps
residual_findings.note: Random keychain password echoed to GITHUB_OUTPUT exposes secret via steps.keychain.outputs.keychain_pass in GitHub Actions summary and any step that reads step outputs. Cleanup step uses security delete-keychain (no password required); signing steps run in same shell invocation where password is in scope. Fix: remove echo "keychain_pass=$keychain_pass" line.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed in V1.72 Greptile hotfix PR #98 (merged at e41392a1b7e604297e0554ef0bfd8cb73ca547b7); review thread resolved by Greptile (5/5 confidence).

residual_findings.title: split_frontmatter matches \n--- anywhere, not just bare delimiter line
residual_findings.note:
after_open.find("
---") matches substring anywhere, including "
---more-text" or YAML block scalar starting line with ---. User-defined chapter title or timeline event description containing --- at line start, serialized by serde_yaml without quoting, could cause premature frontmatter split. Fix: match "
---
" (or only at end-of-string) to enforce bare delimiter line.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed in V1.72 Greptile hotfix PR #98 (merged at e41392a1b7e604297e0554ef0bfd8cb73ca547b7); review thread resolved by Greptile (5/5 confidence).

residual_findings.title: Redundant `patch` object dep alongside `patch.isPending` primitive (greploop iter 1)
residual_findings.target: V1.72 greploop iter 1 (greploop feedback during PR #98 review)
residual_findings.note: `patch` object reference is stable in TanStack Query v5; listing it alongside the narrower `patch.isPending` primitive dep causes handleSave to re-create unnecessarily. Fix: removed `patch` from deps; kept `patch.isPending` as narrow primitive; `patch.mutateAsync` is stable per TanStack Query v5.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed in greploop iter 1: cc7dde17 dropped `patch` from useCallback deps across 3 inspectors; `patch.isPending` retained as narrow primitive dep. Tests pass (156/156).
